Case: Kwok is a 52-year-old with hepatitis C and cirrhosis who presents with new abdominal pain. Kwok was preparing breakfast when he had sudden onset of sharp pain in his right upper abdomen. The safe approach: give low dose (0.5 mg) IV hydromorphone, monitor closely.
